tools.Name: Crawl4AI
tools.Description: An open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler and scraper that converts complex web pages into clean, structured Markdown, making it ideal for RAG and AI agent workflows.
tools.Use_Case: Automated data collection for research, training data generation, and integrating real-time web content into AI workflows.

tools.Name: OpenMontage
tools.Description: A comprehensive agentic video production system that manages pipelines for scripting, asset generation, editing, and final composition using various AI tools.
tools.Use_Case: Automating the creation of cinematic trailers, animated explainers, and documentary montages from text prompts or reference videos.

tools.Name: VoiceStudio
tools.Description: A fully local, open-source alternative to ElevenLabs that provides voice cloning, video dubbing, dictation, and audiobook creation.
tools.Use_Case: Generating high-quality, expressive synthetic speech and dubbing video content entirely on local hardware without subscriptions or API fees.
